vendors.name: Netwrix Auditor
vendors.offering: Audits user activity and changes across AD, Entra ID, M365, file servers, Windows Server
vendors.pricing: Essentials self-service from $20 per enabled AD user + cloud-only Entra ID user (up to 250 identities); larger estates quote-only

vendors.name: ManageEngine ADAudit Plus
vendors.offering: AD, Azure AD, file server, member server and workstation logon/change auditing
vendors.pricing: Annual per server: 2 DCs $595 Standard / $945 Professional; Azure AD tenant from $995; 2 Windows file servers $495

vendors.name: Quest Change Auditor
vendors.offering: Real-time who-changed-what auditing for AD, Entra ID, Exchange, SQL Server, file systems
vendors.pricing: not public (licensed per enabled user account via resellers)

vendors.name: Lepide Auditor (Lepide Data Security Platform)
vendors.offering: Change and activity auditing for AD, file servers, Entra ID and other platforms
vendors.pricing: not public; quoted per user, per year, per platform (Core/Plus/Advanced tiers)

vendors.name: Syteca (formerly Ekran System)
vendors.offering: Session recording and user activity monitoring on servers and desktops
vendors.pricing: not public; licensed per monitored endpoint plus management panel

vendors.name: Teleport
vendors.offering: Infrastructure access with SSH, desktop, Kubernetes session recording and structured audit logs
vendors.pricing: Billed on monthly active users and protected resources; list price not public

vendors.name: StrongDM
vendors.offering: Privileged access proxy for servers and databases with session recording and audit trails
vendors.pricing: Single per-user SKU, list price not public; AWS Marketplace lists $840 per additional user

vendors.name: AdminDroid Office 365 Reporter
vendors.offering: Microsoft 365 audit reporting with retention beyond native audit log window
vendors.pricing: Free edition plus premium Standard/Pro editions with add-on packs; prices not public

paid_market_gaps.gap: Per-enabled-user licensing becomes very expensive for organizations with thousands of AD accounts
Microsoft 365 audit history beyond 180 days needs E5 or audit add-on per user; E3/Business tenants underserved
Each source (DCs, Entra tenants, file servers, workstations) is priced as a separate add-on, inflating mixed-estate cost
Free Linux session recording (tlog) is unreliable for root and loses recordings on reboot by default

wtp_evidence: Established auditing products publish prices SMBs buy (ADAudit Plus from $595/yr, Netwrix from $20/user); Netwrix Capterra reviewers mostly cite setup, reporting and usability issues; several praise its cost.
bundling_note: Microsoft (Purview Audit, 180 days standard) and AWS (90-day free CloudTrail event history) bundle native logs, but unified cross-system on-prem server/DB/AD review is not given away.
summary: Crowded, mature market (Netwrix, ManageEngine, Quest, Lepide, PAM vendors) with cloud-native logs bundled. Only narrow wedge: cheap, per-server-priced unified activity review plus long M365 retention for SMBs priced out of per-user tools.
